title: Enhancements to RTL documents
summary: Enhancements to RTL documents, improved PowerPoint text alignment and autofit, and fixes for French translations.

items.body: Enhancements to RTL documents in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF
Improved PowerPoint text alignment and autofit
Improved Word text sizing after translation
Improved Word preview for RTL documents
Fixed stray bullets in French translations
Fixed the unsynced marker on edited segments
